ammunition.note: Drag curve fitted to the published SS109 downrange velocities (914 -> 451 m/s at 500 m). Penetration anchor: 3.5 mm mild steel at 570-640 m (the bullet is at about 340 m/s at 640 m; set slightly lower for margin), which also gives the published 9.5 mm steel door at up to 100 m. Soft-core bullet: against masonry, concrete, soil and wood its penetration does not rise above the 200 m value (US manual: penetration peaks at 200 m, the round breaks up at close range). Bullet diameter from memory. See docs/research/ballistics.md (values from search extracts of the cited pages).

Soft-core tracer: mass and burn distance from the manufacturer; drag slightly above ball and reduced penetration are game values. See docs/research/ballistics.md (values from search extracts of the cited pages).
